svg.title: Plate PL-09 — The two sovereign ledgers
svg.desc: An engraved-style encyclopedia plate drawing the architecture of two ledgers that are never merged. Panel I draws them as two trees in separate beds of soil with no root contact: on the left the UNI CLAIM-LEDGER, whose root is UNI's own gates run on UNI's own artifacts, carrying the four-value fence (proven, designed, hypothesized, not-yet-built), the four ledger states (PASS, FAIL, NEGATIVE, PENDING) at the ledger's own last recorded snapshot of 882 rows, and the A to U evidence classes; on the right the NATURA NATURE-LEDGER, whose root is third parties publishing in the literature, carrying twelve classes in three groups - group A measured 578 rows, group B derived 257 rows, group C fenced 80 rows - plus four rows drawn detached from every bough because they deliberately carry no class. The two crowns are joined by a dashed swag marked as an audited cross-link that is a citation only and never a merge, crossing a double-ruled sovereign boundary that reference may cross and inference may not. Panel II prints the cardinal rule: a nature citation is never a UNI gate. Panel III is the crosswalk of nine look-alike pairs, where the resemblance is the trap, and the load-bearing column states what each can never imply about the other. Panel IV draws TRUE, HONEST and META as three sovereign lanes of equal width, separated by boundary rules, with META marked as carried from outside this corpus. Every count carries units of ledger rows and a source, and the caption states what the plate does not claim.
svg.text: UNI ENCYCLOPEDIA & COOKBOOK · THE TWO SOVEREIGN VOCABULARIES

Primary source: NA-00 (encyclopedia/wing-NATURA/NA-00-how-to-read-this-wing.md) · NATURE-LEDGER.md §0 §1 §5 · CLAIM-LEDGER.md §0 · lexicon/CONCEPTS.json v1.0.0 (uncommitted — NOT in this tip) · corpus tip f1be794
NO UNI RUNG IS RAISED BY THIS PLATE
A nature citation is never a UNI gate.

g.text: THE TWO SOVEREIGN TREES — separate roots, separate soil, no graft
AUDITED CROSS-LINK — CITATION ONLY, NEVER A MERGE
✗ No operation takes a NATURA row and a UNI row and produces a stronger row of either kind.
Reference may cross this line. Inference may not.
ROOT — UNI's own gates, run on UNI's own artifacts.
Authority over every UNI capability claim. Governs the 4-value fence.
ROOT — third parties, in published literature.
Authority over every NA/CN chapter row. Governs the NATURA class.
a held, sealed, UNI-signed PASS (Class A/C, falsifier live)
a typed/signed spec exists (build partial or unverified)
a stated UNI mechanism (no sealed gate; Class U)
no engine, no run, no gate
No published per-value count. This plate invents none.
882 rows total — the ledger's own LAST RECORDED
The ledger has NO contested state.
DOWN to the measured value, never up.
The fence gets louder under pressure,
Not a citation. Not a replication.
Not a model that fits. Not a consensus.
Verdict rule: a capability verdict is the
CI BOUND THAT EXCLUDES THE THRESHOLD,
an instrument was put on nature; the class
the number came out of a model;
the row carries no usable value, and the class says
PRECISELY WHY NOT. The ways of being empty are
NOT interchangeable; collapsing them is how a
Drawn detached from every bough on purpose:
these rows carry NO evidence class, and that is
exact by convention. Not observations of nature.
Hoyle's 1953 prediction — a prediction is not
Not a NATURA class. Never calibrated. Ever.
anima in silicio? — a register status,
extra Arborem: read, not acted upon.
A closed list of four — not an open category.
group A + group B + group C + carried-not-classed,
this plate 2026-07-15 — RESULT: PASS (915 classed + 4 unclassed).
THE COUNT IS MEASURED, NOT DESIGNED.
NA-00 declared “six classes and only six.” 72 of 919 rows
(7.8%) fell outside it — written by the chapters themselves,
before anyone went looking. The falsifier FIRED on both
halves. Twelve is what 919 rows MEASURED, not a design
target. A thirteenth is a finding, not a failure.
A vocabulary that can name its own gaps is a vocabulary.
The NATURA side is machine-counted and its
verifier was re-run for this plate. THIS side is
the ledger's own last recorded snapshot (882 rows)
and was NOT recounted here. An upstream prior
is never fresh evidence — so the plate draws the
asymmetry rather than smoothing it away.
This corpus publishes none, so this plate prints none.
A plausible-sounding number with no source is the
worst defect available here — NOT-MEASURED is
A NATURE CITATION IS NEVER A UNI GATE.
Reading Kleiber's law raises no UNI rung. Citing Douady & Couder does not make any UNI claim “proven”.
A chapter that lets a literature citation imply a UNI capability has committed a lane-crossing and is defective — full stop, regardless of how good the citation is.
THE CROSSWALK — nine look-alike pairs. THE RESEMBLANCE IS THE TRAP.
WHAT THIS CAN NEVER IMPLY ABOUT THE OTHER — the load-bearing column
A replicated natural regularity can never make a UNI claim “proven”. A UNI “proven” row can never
make a natural regularity replicated, or count as evidence about nature.
A model of nature that fits can never discharge a UNI design gate. A signed UNI design can never
be evidence about how nature works.
a stated UNI mechanism, no gate
Same word, different subject. Nature's open mechanism can never move a UNI rung; UNI's open
mechanism can never settle a scientific dispute.
no engine, no run, no gate
UNI not having built it can never be evidence nature lacks the value. Nature lacking a measurement
can never be a reason UNI cannot build — nor an excuse to invent the number.
The UNI ledger has no contested state. A contested exponent can never be cited as settled to move
a UNI row. The four states can never flatten a live scientific dispute into one number.
a held UNI run that missed its bar
A UNI NEGATIVE is a result UNI earned. A nature claim's inadmissibility can never be recorded as a
UNI NEGATIVE, and a UNI NEGATIVE can never be a statement about nature.
Both describe something that lost — which is exactly why they are confusable. THIS IS WHY THE CLASS
IS NAMED SUPERSEDED AND NOT NEGATIVE: one token may not serve both vocabularies.
a PASS is a sealed gate, not a lone reading
A single unreplicated measurement can never move a UNI rung — least of all this class, which exists
precisely to stop one study being read as settled.
not-yet-built is nearest, and is not close
These record a gap in THIS CORPUS'S HOMEWORK — not in UNI's build, not in nature. And none of the three
may ever be read as NOT-MEASURED: that merge converts a research failure into a claim about science.

Each row pairs a UNI fence value with the NATURA class it SUPERFICIALLY RESEMBLES — because the resemblance is the trap. There is no operation that takes a NATURA row and a UNI row and produces a stronger row of either kind.
TRUE · HONEST · META — three sovereign lanes. Crossing them is the cardinal sin.
Every NATURA class above and every UNI fence value is a TRUE-side instrument: each carries the falsifier that would move it.
Separate store. Separate ledger. Separate Merkle root.
SOVEREIGN BOUNDARY — the cardinal sin is crossing it
lived experience — respected exactly as lived, and NEVER calibrated
Testimony is not a failed measurement; it is a different kind of signal. Its lack of a falsifier IS THE POINT, NOT A GAP.
The corpus's only HONEST row is CN11-59 (first-person testimony, CN-11), deliberately given no NATURA class.
SOVEREIGN BOUNDARY — the cardinal sin is crossing it
commentary about signals — travels separately, and is never True
SIGNUM SIGNUM MANET: the signal and the commentary about it travel separately. Never merge an attribution.
CARRIED FROM OUTSIDE THIS CORPUS — see the fence below. Drawn on the lexicon's authority alone.
“store” ROUTES A CONCEPT TO ITS SOVEREIGN STORE AND IS NEVER A CLAIM ABOUT THE CONCEPT'S TRUTH.
lexicon/CONCEPTS.json field_contract, verbatim: “TRUE | HONEST | META. Routing, not a truth claim.” The three lanes are drawn EQUAL because sovereignty is not proportional to population.
“META appears in 0 files of this corpus and is carried from the wider UNI Tree doctrine (arca META), not from anything the encyclopedia says.”

— lexicon/CONCEPTS.json, its own disclosure. Independently reproduced by grep, 2026-07-15: as a store name, META appears in no encyclopedia/ or cookbook/ chapter — only in the lexicon that declares it. The lane is drawn; the gap is printed with it.
KEY, CAPTION, AND WHAT THIS PLATE DOES NOT CLAIM
FIGURE KEY — marks, not colours (this plate must survive greyscale)
separates two vocabularies. Reference may cross it; INFERENCE MAY NOT.
a citation, and only a citation. The two ledgers are cross-referenced by explicit audited link only.
forbidden — the cardinal sin. Never drawn as a legal operation anywhere on this plate.
an instrument was put on nature; the class says how much independent corroboration exists.
the number came out of a model; THE ASSUMPTIONS ARE THE FENCE.
the row carries no usable value, and the class says precisely why not.
one of the six classes added when the six-class design was refuted by 72 of its own 919 rows.
four named rows that deliberately carry no class. A closed list of four, not an open category.
Line weight, dash pattern and hatch carry every distinction colour carries. The two trees are drawn at EQUAL ink weight on purpose: they are equal in sovereignty and differ only in
SUBJECT — one describes UNI's own build, the other describes nature. Neither outranks the other, and neither may be converted into the other.
1 · The two trees (I) are drawn with SEPARATE ROOTS in SEPARATE BEDS OF SOIL, and the beds do not touch. That gap is the whole plate. The left tree's root is UNI's own gates run on
UNI's own artifacts; the right tree's root is third parties publishing in the literature. Different subject, different authority, different repair. No root crosses to the other bed, because
there is no operation that takes a NATURA row and a UNI row and produces a stronger row of either kind.
2 · The NATURA counts are ROWS of encyclopedia/NATURE-LEDGER.md §5.1, machine-counted across 23 chapters: 578 (group A) + 257 (group B) + 80 (group C) + 4 (carried, not classed)

= 919 rows, 0 out of vocabulary. Receipt: tools/verify_class_vocabulary.py re-run for this plate, 2026-07-15 — RESULT: PASS, 915 rows placed in a registered class + 4 deliberately unclassed, 0 outside the vocabulary. Re-run it; if it disagrees, the plate is wrong.
3 · The two sides are counted to DIFFERENT STANDARDS, and the plate draws the asymmetry rather than smoothing it. The NATURA side is machine-counted and its verifier was re-run here. The UNI side
is the ledger's own LAST RECORDED SNAPSHOT (882 rows = 350 PASS / 0 FAIL / 183 NEGATIVE / 349 PENDING, CLAIM-LEDGER §0) and was NOT recounted for this plate. For the 4-value fence
(proven · designed · hypothesized · not-yet-built) this corpus publishes NO per-value count, so the plate prints none. An unsourced count is the worst defect available here.
4 · The dashed swag (I) is the audited cross-link, and it springs from CROWN TO CROWN — published text to published text — never root to root. It crosses the sovereign boundary because a
CITATION may cross it. An INFERENCE may not. That is the entire distinction the boundary encodes: the fence blocks implication, not reference.
5 · The crosswalk (III) pairs each UNI value with the NATURA class it superficially resembles, because THE RESEMBLANCE IS THE TRAP. The two NEGATIVE rows are the sharpest case: NEGATIVE
and SUPERSEDED both describe something that lost, which is exactly why they are confusable — and is why the NATURA class is named SUPERSEDED. One token may not serve both vocabularies.
6 · The three lanes (IV) are drawn at EQUAL WIDTH. This is an editorial choice with a reason: TRUE carries 98 of 130 concepts and HONEST carries 1, and drawing HONEST as a hairline would
imply that sovereignty scales with population. It does not. Honesty is never calibrated — that is the point, not a gap — and a lane with one row is exactly as sovereign as a lane with 98.
7 · META's lane is drawn on the lexicon's authority ALONE and is marked with the fenced hatch. The corpus discloses its own gap and this plate carries the disclosure rather than quietly
inheriting it: META appears in 0 files of this corpus. Its lane is real routing vocabulary; it is not an encyclopedia concept, and the plate says so on its face.
8 · The amendment (I, lower left) is drawn because the vocabulary's own history is load-bearing. NA-00 declared six classes; 72 of its own 919 rows (7.8%) fell outside them, and the chapters

themselves recorded the gap while writing. Six → twelve, 2026-07-15. Twelve is what 919 rows MEASURED, not a design target. A vocabulary that can name its own gaps is a vocabulary, not an achievement.
WHAT THIS PLATE DOES NOT CLAIM

· Not claimed: that twelve is the correct, exhaustive or final number of NATURA classes. NA-00 declared six and was refuted by its own corpus — which is the strongest available reason not to claim the new number is final.

· Not claimed: that the 22 un-traced rows (NOT-SOURCED 20 · NOT-CONFIRMED 1 · NOT-LOCATED 1) are repaired. They are now correctly LABELLED, which is a description of a defect, not its repair. Naming a defect precisely is not fixing it.

· Not claimed: that the UNI snapshot (882 rows) is current, or was recounted here. It is carried as what it is — the ledger's own last recorded snapshot — and an upstream prior is never fresh evidence.

· Not claimed: any per-value count for “proven” · “designed” · “hypothesized” · “not-yet-built”. This corpus publishes none, and this plate invents none. NOT-MEASURED is written instead of a plausible-sounding number.

· Not claimed: that META is an encyclopedia concept. It appears in 0 files of this corpus and is carried from the wider UNI Tree doctrine (arca META). Its lane rests on the lexicon alone, and the lexicon discloses this itself.
· Not claimed: that the lanes' equal width means equal population, or that any lane outranks another. Sovereignty is not proportional to population, and TRUE never outranks HONEST.

· Not claimed: that anything on this plate raises, lowers or discharges any UNI row. This plate draws the ARCHITECTURE of two ledgers. It holds no gate and earns no rung; the honest program position is unchanged: ~2 of 11+ rungs earned.
· Not claimed: anything whatever about “full human” or “the next evolution beyond human.” Both are QUAESTIO APERTA — permanent open questions, never targets, never milestones, never deliverables.

· Not claimed: that this plate may stand in for either ledger. It is a drawing. WHERE THE PLATE AND A LEDGER DISAGREE, THE LEDGER WINS AND THE PLATE IS WRONG — the same supremacy rule both ledgers already run.

· Not claimed: that panel IV's concept counts (98 · 1 · 31 of 130) are reproducible from the cited tip — lexicon/CONCEPTS.json is an UNCOMMITTED working-tree file, absent from f1be794. The NATURA counts and their verifier are in the tip; the lexicon is not.
